budget_pilot_detail.bh: 10 seeds x 100000 (campaign pilot-bcl1) + 20 seeds x 150000 (campaign pilot-bcl1-long)

gm_motif: perfect fcc truncated octahedron (coordination 24x6, 8x9, 6x12; CNA 421/311/211/200), Cu-Cu 2.46-2.48 A
notes: The NEP89 GM is the fcc truncated octahedron, as for Gupta/Sutton-Chen Cu38 (Doye & Wales, New J. Chem. 22, 733 (1998); Cambridge Cluster Database). The main trap is a non-fcc (decahedral/icosahedral, CNA 555/422) structure at +0.107 eV, giving an LJ38-like double funnel. BH found the TO in 9 of 30 runs (3/10 at 100000, 6/20 at 150000); RS never did (best gap 0.129 eV). The 9 hits are all the TO (spread 5.5 meV, one less tightly relaxed), so e_tol = 0.02. 3 x median BH hit step (89558) = 268700 exceeds the cap, so the final budget is clamped to 150000 (about 5.3 min per BH run). This is the hardest benchmark of the set: BH SR is about 0.3.
